fact: The Ministry of Higher Education's planning and statistics office published the 7th edition of the Anuario Estatistico do Ensino Superior in December 2023, covering academic year 2020-21 (graduates of 2019), compiled from seven administrative primary registers supplied by higher-education institutions.

The Anuario Estatistico Sanitario 2023, compiled by the health ministry's planning and statistics office from the Sistema de Informacao Sanitaria records, was released through INE on 6 April 2026, covering 2023.
